texts.preamble: Mr. Rishi Bhatnagar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 January, 2024 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Raj Mohan Singh On The 18 th Of January, 2024 Misc. Criminal Case No. 22262 of 2016 Between:- 1. Mr. Rishi Bhatnagar S/O Late Shri H.M. Bhatnagar, R/O 28/101, East End Apartment, Mayur Vihar, P.H. -1, Extion Vihar, New Delhi (Delhi) 2. Mr. Anil Chandani S/O Shri Bhagwandas D Chandani, R/O Ata/16, Bema Nagar, Mv Road, Andhari East, ,Mumbai (Maharashtra) ... (By Shri Anil Khare, Senior Advocate With Shri R.S. Siddiqui - Advocate) And The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Inspector, Legal Metrology Dept.
texts.facts: The inspection of petroleum pump was carried out on 11.03.2016. Some irregularities were detected during the inspection i.e., the fuel dispensing machines were found to be deficient as the same were not calibrated in accordance with the Legal Mr. Rishi Bhatnagar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70160984/ 1 Metrology Act, 2009 (for brevity, the 'Act, 2009'). A complaint was filed against the applicants in their personal capacities and other accused person by the Department of Weights and Measures. In the complaint so filed by the complainant, the names of the applicants figure at serial no.7 & 8 in the array of accused.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicants contends that M/s Gilbarco Veeder- Root India Pvt. Ltd. is a company registered under the Companies Act, 1956. Learned counsel for the applicants, with reference to the contents of the complaint Annexure-A/7 (brought on record as additional document in I.A. No.825), contends that the complaint itself is silent as regard the status and role of the applicants in any capacity what to talk of their status being that of Directors. Since the Company itself has been arrayed as accused no.10, therefore, the complainant is legally required to show the manner in which the applicants are liable for the omission, if any, done by the Company in not calibrating the fuel dispensing machines in accordance with the Act, 2009. The applicants have not been shown to be the Directors in the Company and their roles have not been defined as to how they are liable for day to day affairs of the Company in ordinary course of business. Even the Company has not been impleaded through some responsible person of the Company. The applicants have been arrayed as accused by names without their being any designation attached to them. Learned counsel for the applicants, with reference to additional documents on record, submits that the applicant no.1 is not having any designation in the Company nor has the same mentioned in the complaint as to in which capacity, the applicant no.1 has been arrayed as one of the accused. The issue is similar to the requirement of law in Negotiable Instruments Act, Fertilizer Control Order, The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 and provision in terms of Section 17(4) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act Mr. Rishi Bhatnagar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70160984/ 2 which is pari materia with Section 46 of the Legal Metrology Act.
